lines: The podcast argues that professional networks are shifting away from static resumes toward dynamic, reputation-based systems driven by peer endorsements.
Cosign highlights that the most impactful contributors often remain invisible within traditional top-down organizational hierarchies.
The platform integrates AI agents to continuously scan the network and actively surface relevant opportunities based on user-defined criteria.
Recognition initiatives like the Cosign Awards act as community-building catalysts to connect high-potential individuals for future collaboration.
title: The Professional Network Built for You and Your AI Agent
